data.narrative:
Salient Motion is a Series A robotics and manufacturing company that has raised $12M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable set of nine private companies and one public entity operating in the same sector, including peers at seed through Series B stages such as Humanoid, Bedrock Robotics, Dexterity, Generalist AI, and Walden Robotics.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression modeling applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier to the $12M total raised as a proxy for current value, yielding $24M. Peer-median analysis examines five same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables with valuations ranging from $1.1B to $2.0B and a median of $1.6B, reflecting the substantial valuations observed in this competitive robotics space. The peer cohort spans seed through Series B, with Humanoid at $1.4B (Series A) and Walden Robotics at $1.1B (seed) providing stage-relevant anchors.

The triangulated analysis produces a wide range: $20M (low) to $1.9B (high), with a median of $837M. This dispersion reflects fundamental uncertainty about Salient Motion's technology differentiation, IP moat, and market traction relative to better-capitalized peers. The stage-progression method yields valuations orders of magnitude below peer medians, suggesting either that Salient Motion is materially earlier in development or that peer valuations reflect sector-wide froth. Resolution requires deeper diligence into proprietary capabilities and near-term revenue trajectory.
